versions.content: Data transformation of inter-ECU communication Type: valid Description: The System Template shall provide the means to describe data transformation for inter-ECU communication. Rationale: If data of an inter-ECU communication shall be transformed, this has to be configured within the System to enable sending and receiving ECUs to execute the data transformation. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Large composite data shall be mapped in one go to bus communication to avoid the mapping of each atomic element of the composite data. Supporting Material: –
